comment: Three mechanisms. 'priority_draws': chance to force a specific room into slot 3 whenever it is draftable, once per slot-3 attempt -- targeted either by an explicit 'rooms' list (a named set) or by a 'category' selector resolved at draw time to every room carrying that category (draft.py::_priority_draw). 'forced_draws': a DIFFERENT mechanic (wiki.gg/Drafting/Advanced) -- once per day, the first time a doorway is opened where a listed room's own draft conditions + a gate are met, roll a very-high chance to push that specific room into slot 3; on success it is unavailable for the rest of the day even if the placement itself then fails (e.g. the room already occupies an earlier slot of the same hand). 'category_biases': conditional biases that force a category re-deal with the given chance while their condition holds, on every slot it is rolled for (King's Chess Piece variants, constellations, room auras). Chances are fractions.

sheet constants: 'Chronograph 40% Tomorrow Rooms'; blueprince.wiki.gg/wiki/Chronograph datamined box: 'This is a Priority Draw (40% for all Tomorrow Rooms)'.
meta.notes: Live: condition 'chronograph' is emitted by _active_conditions while a Chronograph is held (special_items.json effect tag 'chronograph', checked via chronograph_active_from_state). 'category' resolves at draw time to every room whose category is 'tomorrow' (draft.py::_priority_draw, matching Room.is_category rather than a hand-typed room list, so a future Tomorrow-room addition is picked up automatically) -- Clock Tower, Coat Check, Freezer, Mail Room plus its three upgrades, Morning Room, Planetarium, Sauna, the Hallway's Tomorrow upgrade, and the Break Room. The item's other effect, rewinding a redraw, is also live: Game.can_rewind/rewind pop PendingDraft.rewind_stack, driven by env/actions.py's REWIND_ACTION.

meta.source: blueprince.wiki.gg/wiki/Drafting/Advanced: patio_rooms clause 'Secret Passage is included if Greenhouse has not been drafted'; garage_classroom clause 'Secret Passage included after Greenhouse effect is active'
meta.notes: Both clauses are keyed off the single signal state.greenhouse_placed -- the same one chance_with_greenhouse already uses on patio_rooms -- so the room sits in exactly one of the two entries' rooms lists in every state (draft.py::_apply_membership_moves; asserted by tests/test_secret_passage_membership.py). Simplification disclosed: the wiki's two clauses are worded differently ('has not been drafted' vs 'effect is active'), and since the Greenhouse filter is 'the same filter as king', a King's-green activation could, read literally and independently, satisfy 'effect is active' with no Greenhouse drafted -- this model does not distinguish that case.

meta.notes: Only the Garage slice of forced_draw_precedence is implemented (owner decision); the conservatory/morning_room/utility_closet forced draws themselves remain unbuilt, even though two of their three prerequisites are already live: Found Floorplan (decks.py::eligible_pool's found_floorplan pool, gated on cfg.conservatory_floorplan_found) and Bacon & Eggs (effects/rooms/nook.py sets the breakfast draft-condition and injects the room) are both built; only Garage-drafted-first (utility_closet) is unconfirmed. The separate Day-5-or-Veteran 3% passive Priority Draw for the Garage (wiki) is a different, unimplemented mechanic -- do not conflate the two gates.

colour_defaults.comment: Per-colour default floorplans for a colour-selective draft (wiki.gg/Drafting_effects, 'List of default floorplans for each selectable color type'), tried in order once the ordinary pool draw comes up empty. 'swap' replaces one default with another while any of 'swap_when_upgraded' is applied: the Cloister leaves green when upgraded, and the Solarium takes its place.

day1_opening_draw.comment: A Guaranteed Draw (wiki.gg/Drafting/Advanced, 'Special Draws > Guaranteed Draws'), NOT one of this file's priority_draws/forced_draws/category_biases mechanisms above -- a Guaranteed Draw runs ahead of the normal drafting algorithm and fixes all three slots of the hand at once, not one slot within an otherwise-normal draw. Applies only to the very first draw of Day 1 (draft.py: state.day == 1 and state.drafts_today == 1 and the hand's first round); the wiki notes ending Day 1 without drafting simply skips it, which needs no code since the guarantee only ever fires from an actual draft.

meta.source: blueprince.wiki.gg/wiki/Drafting/Advanced, Special Draws > Guaranteed Draws: 'The very first draw on Day 1 is Bedroom, Closet, and Hallway in that order. Ending Day 1 without drafting skips this forced draw.'
